infobox.Events: 7th Anniversary | Apex Legends X Gundam File:Aftershock.svg Aftershock

details: [Passive] New -> Momentum Boost: If Gibraltar maintains sprint speed for a couple of seconds he will get a speed boost. This will only trigger while unarmed or if the weapon doesn't have a sprint speed restriction. Gibraltar punch will deal double damage to Hardlight
[Tactical] Buff -> Cooldown on Dome of Protection reduced (was 17s, now 13s)
[Ultimate] Buff -> Integrated the size increase upgrade into his base kit, increasing radius by 20%
[Ultimate] Buff -> Call in time for the missiles has been sped up
[Ultimate] Buff -> Can now throw your ultimate before the ultimate equip animation finishes
[Perks] New -> Thunder Dome: The dome becomes electrified when placed, and will deal 50 damage and slow the first enemy to enter
[Perks] New -> Healing Dome: Dome duration increases 4s and any player within the healing dome will get double small meds healing
[Perks] New -> Triple Bombardment: Splits the ultimate into 3 charges, reducing the radius and number of missiles for each
[Perks] Removed -> Big Bruddah, Bubble Bunker, Baby Bubble
[Tactical] Buff -> Integrated the tactical cooldown reduction upgrade into her base kit (was 20s, now 15s)
[Ultimate] Buff -> Integrated the ultimate cooldown reduction upgrade into her base kit (was 2.5 minutes, now 1.5 minutes)
[Ultimate] Buff -> Increased casting speed animation for quicker activation

[Perks] New -> Phase Dome: When Wraith starts channeling her ultimate she will create a Phase Dome. This dome will last for 30s or until Wraith places her portal. Anyone who enters the Phase Dome will go into the void.
[Perks] Buff -> Phase Jumper: Wraith will stay in the void for longer when using her tactical (was 4s, now 6s) and will gain double jump while in the void
[Tactical] Buff -> Placing a fence in front of a Hardlight mesh will reinforce it; if the mesh is broken the fence will rebuild and reinforce it
[Tactical] Buff -> Reduced fence deployment time (was 1s, now 0.5s)
[Ultimate] Buff -> When Wattson’s ultimate is placed it will reinforce Hardlight meshes in the zone of the pylon; if the mesh is broken it will rebuild and reinforce the mesh.
